entities.name: Carlos de Morais Camisão
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos de Morais Camisão was a Brazilian colonel of the Paraguayan War. He was one of the leaders of the retreat from Laguna, with Alfredo d'Escragnolle Taunay. He took command of the Brazilian force counter-attacking the Paraguayan invasion during the Mato Grosso Campaign, but died of cholera during the retreat.

entities.summary: Carlos de Morais Camisão was a Brazilian colonel of the Paraguayan War. He was one of the leaders of the retreat from Laguna, with Alfredo d'Escragnolle Taunay. He took command of the Brazilian force counter-attacking the Paraguayan invasion during the Mato Grosso Campaign, but died of cholera during the retreat.
